micro_chops.description: Very small sample slices applied in rhythmic sequence

phrase_chops.description: Longer chopped sample phrases reused with variation

reverse_chops.description: Reversed sample slices layered for texture

vocal_chops.description: Sliced vocal samples arranged to create rhythmic hooks

stutter_chops.description: Quick repeated rapidly sliced sample fragments

sound_intent.style: West Coast Hip-Hop aggressive instrumental with sample-based hooks

track_roles.drums: rhythmic backbone with stutter chop samples
track_roles.chords: harmonic structure with micro chop samples

designer_intent.overall_goal: Create an aggressive, hook-heavy instrumental arrangement using sample chop techniques distinctive to West Coast Hip-Hop style.

presetor_intent.focus: Track balancing emphasizing vocal chop hooks and drum rhythm intensity in hooks.

sensei_drum.brief: Design energetic drum patterns emphasizing stutter chops to drive aggressive rhythm.

bass_generator.brief: Generate a solid bassline foundation supporting the hook-heavy sections with stable low end.

harmony_generator.brief: Create chord progressions using micro choppings to build tension and atmosphere.

melody_generator.brief: Arrange phrase chopped melodic samples that complement the hook sections.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement flow, energy curve shaping with sample chopping techniques integration.

presetor.brief: Adjust mix presets to highlight vocal chops and punchy drums for hook sections.

songgps.brief: Manage section transitions and energy distribution emphasizing hook-heavy parts.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Balance unprocessed channel audio maintaining clarity and aggression.
